title: An ordinary agreement-open criterion extends to arbitrary maps
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F a sheaf of sets on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], Q an etale object over S, s,t in F(Q), and E an open of Q. Suppose for every etale object A/S and map m:A -> Q over S that range(m) is contained in E if and only if F(m)(s)=F(m)(t). Then for every scheme T and arbitrary map a:T -> Q, range(a) is contained in E if and only if the canonical restrictions of s and t agree in (a composed with Q -> S)^(-1)F(T). Canonical restriction is the adjunction unit followed by restriction along (a,id_T) into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units].

source.place: Tag 09XM (lemma-where-sections-are-equal), applied over the etale object Q; Tag 03S2 for ordinary etale restriction

proof.text: Choose the canonical open W with its arbitrary-map factorization criterion.

For each ordinary etale test m:A -> Q, compare canonical restriction with F(m) using the restriction isomorphism for A -> S. Its unit formula and naturality identify the sections after two injective isomorphism components, hence reflect equality. The restriction comparison accepts an explicit structural map w and a proof m.left composed with Q.hom equals w; equality elimination with w=A.hom handles transport within this comparison, so no separate canonicalSection_eq_iff theorem is required.

An arbitrary map factors through an open exactly when its range is contained in that open: use IsOpenImmersion.lift in one direction and evaluate the factorization on points in the other. Test the own open immersions of E and W in their common ordinary criterion to get both inclusions and E=W. Substitute into W's arbitrary-map criterion.

theorem etaleSections_equal_open_arbitrary_criterion
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (Q : S.Etale) (s t : F.obj.obj (op Q)) (E : Q.left.Opens)
    (hE : ∀ (A : S.Etale) (m : A ⟶ Q),
      Set.range m.left ⊆ (E : Set Q.left) ↔ F.obj.map m.op s = F.obj.map m.op t) :
    ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (a : T ⟶ Q.left),
      let H := (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (a ≫ Q.hom)).obj F
      let δ : Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T) ⟶
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (a ≫ Q.hom)).obj Q :=
        MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
          (pullback.lift a (𝟙 T) (Category.id_comp (a ≫ Q.hom)).symm)
          (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)
      let η := ((@Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous _ _ _ _
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (a ≫ Q.hom)) (Type (u + 1)) _
        (S.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
        (T.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
        (Etale.isContinuous_overPullback (a ≫ Q.hom)) _ _).unit.app F).hom.app (op Q)
      Set.range a ⊆ (E : Set Q.left) ↔ H.obj.map δ.op (η s) = H.obj.map δ.op (η t)
